target pc

struct Vertex_In
  position: [3]f32  attr:position
  uv: [2]f32  attr:texcoord
  color: [4]f32  attr:color

struct Varying
  position: [4]f32  out:position
  uv: [2]f32  out:texcoord0
  color: [4]f32  out:color

uniform frame: the engine's frame block
  view_projection: matrix[4, 4]f32
uniform render: the engine's render block
  model: matrix[4, 4]f32
  tint: [4]f32
  uv_rectangle: [4]f32
  alpha_cutoff: f32
texture tex: slot 0

proc vertex_main(input#0: Vertex_In) -> Varying  [vertex stage]
  var output#1: Varying = zero
  var world#2: [4]f32 = (render.model * [4]f32{input#0.position.x, input#0.position.y, input#0.position.z, 1.0}):[4]f32
  output#1.position = (frame.view_projection * world#2):[4]f32
  output#1.color = (input#0.color * render.tint):[4]f32
  output#1.uv = lerp(render.uv_rectangle.xy, render.uv_rectangle.zw, input#0.uv):[2]f32
  return output#1

proc fragment_main(v#0: Varying) -> [4]f32  [fragment stage]
  var color#1: [4]f32 = (sample(tex, v#0.uv):[4]f32 * v#0.color):[4]f32
  if (color#1.w < render.alpha_cutoff):bool
    discard()
  return color#1
